cases.prompt: Create a TypeScript Loop component where teammates can update a deployment status from Teams and Outlook.
expected: Uses an Adaptive Card-based Loop component
Scaffolds a Teams message extension with link unfurling
Adds persistence, authorization, optimistic concurrency, and tests

cases.prompt: Convert this existing Teams Adaptive Card into a portable Loop component.
expected: Inspects the existing repository and manifest
Adds a stable canonical URL and metadata.webUrl
Adds refresh and inline actions without duplicating headers
Preserves repository conventions and validates the existing build

cases.prompt: Use Graph API to create a native Loop page and put my custom component in it.
expected: Does not invent a Loop workspace or page creation API
Explains the supported Adaptive Card-based component boundary
Offers to build the component without claiming native page creation
